high_level_description: The image features a close-up of an individual with short, light-colored hair styled in a bob cut. The person is wearing large, dark-framed sunglasses that cover the eyes completely. They are dressed in a black and white patterned jacket over a white top. Around their neck, there is a statement necklace adorned with large, round, purple gemstones interspersed with smaller, clear gemstones, creating a striking contrast against the black and white jacket.
